scheme_name: MMKY-New Tank Excavation Under Brackish Water Aquaculture
other_conditions: Beneficiary must have requisite land free from all encumbrances
Beneficiary must have a bank account in his/her name in Odisha
Beneficiary must provide identity and residential proof, including an Aadhaar Card
One beneficiary family can receive the subsidy only once; no family member should have received a subsidy under this scheme in the last three years
Preference will be given to beneficiaries selected in cluster mode
benefits_summary: Provides up to 40% subsidy for general category and 60% for SC/ST/Women/Transgender/PwD on the cost of excavating a new brackish water tank (up to 2 ha).
